title: Check the deck before you show it

buildSteps.label: Check
buildSteps.description: npm run check -- ./tutorial loads the deck without a browser: every slide's file, every layout name, every picture and video the slides name.

buildSteps.label: Capture
buildSteps.description: npm run capture -- ./tutorial opens every slide and step in a hidden browser, takes a screenshot of each, and lists text that overflows, a title that wraps, media that did not load.

buildSteps.label: Look
buildSteps.description: It prints the path of a contact sheet. Open it: a clean report does not show a slide that is legible but wrong.

buildSteps.label: Or ask
buildSteps.description: “Validate the slides of the tutorial.” An agent runs both, reads the frames, and brings you what it found.
